estimation_policy.primary_rule: Only frames with capture_estimation_eligible=true may enter a preregistered unseen-population estimator.
estimation_policy.note: Expert nominations, curated known-actor seeds, and snowball expansion contribute to N_observed and coverage diagnostics but are excluded from the primary capture estimator because their selection mechanisms are deliberately purposive/dependent.

frames.label: First-party product discovery
frames.purpose: Discover externally represented offerings from manufacturer/vendor catalogues, product pages, manuals, official documentation, and archived official pages.
frames.dependence_notes: Expected overlap with curated-actor, commercial/ecosystem, capability-first, local-language, patent-crossover, and snowball routes; dependence must be diagnosed rather than assumed away.
frames.boundary: Protocol-bounded first-party discovery; no completeness claim.

frames.label: Regulatory discovery
frames.purpose: Discover exact products and configurations from declared regulatory/device registries and authorization/listing records.
frames.dependence_notes: Regulatory capture is indication- and jurisdiction-selective and overlaps first-party, trial, and scientific evidence.
frames.boundary: Exhaustion applies only to every declared provider query/pagination universe.

frames.label: Clinical/trial discovery
frames.purpose: Discover formal investigational offerings and product identities from declared trial registries and study records.
frames.dependence_notes: Trial records overlap regulatory, scientific, and first-party evidence and preferentially sample clinical/investigational products.
frames.boundary: Exhaustion applies only to the declared registry/provider query universe.

frames.label: Scientific/research discovery
frames.purpose: Discover research products, instrumentation, platforms, and named products from scientific publications and research documentation.
frames.dependence_notes: Scientific mentions overlap first-party and trial records and over-sample research/clinical products.
frames.boundary: Protocol-bounded scientific/research discovery; no literature-completeness claim.

frames.label: Commercial/ecosystem discovery
frames.purpose: Discover products through distributors, procurement records, structured industry directories, and funding/investor/accelerator portfolios with attributable product evidence.
frames.dependence_notes: Source classes are heterogeneous and can inherit vendor records; underlying source class must remain explicit and P0.5 must test aggregation sensitivity.
frames.boundary: Commercial/ecosystem capture requires attributable exact-product evidence; listing presence is not commercialization proof.

frames.label: Capability-first discovery
frames.purpose: Recover weakly labelled/non-traditional products through capability and function queries rather than NeuroAI category branding.
frames.dependence_notes: Capability queries can resolve into the same first-party, scientific, commercial, and local-language sources; correlation is expected and must be modeled.
frames.boundary: Capability-first retrieval does not establish scope; exact products still require P0.3/D4 disposition.

frames.label: Expert nominations
frames.purpose: Capture structured expert-nominated products, edge cases, and suspected omissions for recall stress testing.
frames.dependence_notes: Purposive nomination has unknown and highly selective capture probabilities; excluded from the primary unseen estimator.
frames.boundary: Recall/edge-case frame only; no primary capture-estimation role.

frames.label: Local-language discovery
frames.purpose: Measure incremental product discovery from native-language query families and local sources in predeclared language/jurisdiction strata.
frames.dependence_notes: Local-language discovery can recover the same source classes as first-party/scientific/commercial frames; overlap is intentional and measured.
frames.boundary: Matched multilingual sensitivity frame; no inference beyond declared languages/jurisdictions.

frames.label: Curated-actor seed discovery
frames.purpose: Enumerate product evidence for a frozen set of known Observatory actors and other predeclared organization seeds.
frames.dependence_notes: The seed actors are intentionally known and non-probabilistic; this frame improves the observed registry but is excluded from the primary unseen estimator.
frames.boundary: Bounded only by the frozen actor-seed set and declared per-actor enumeration procedure.

frames.label: Patent-commercialization crossover
frames.purpose: Follow a frozen patent/assignee candidate universe to attributable product evidence without treating patent ownership as commercialization.
frames.dependence_notes: Patent-derived actor seeds overlap curated actors, first-party evidence, and commercial sources; patent ownership is only a retrieval lead.
frames.boundary: Patent evidence supplies discovery leads only; inclusion/commercialization requires separate attributable product evidence.

frames.label: Snowball expansion
frames.purpose: Expand from validated products, organizations, trials, distributors, and related products under explicit parent-seed provenance.
frames.dependence_notes: Network expansion is path-dependent and deliberately conditioned on already discovered identities; excluded from the primary unseen estimator.
frames.boundary: Path-dependent recall-expansion frame; contributes to observed coverage but not primary capture estimation.

boundary: The register fixes discovery mechanisms and protocol-bounded stop rules; it does not establish global completeness.
